Would be zero stars if I could, utter incompetence at its finest, put in a repeat prescription for epi pens (life saving medicine) and got rejected twice, took speaking to the practise manager to get this resolved, but prescriptions seem to be a big issue lately, put in a repeat for two of my inhalers, got script for one but not the other, took another argument and getting my respiratory consultant involved to get this rectified, as for rescue packs for asthma they wont prescribe antibiotics as part of it, which means when you need them you have to fight to get anyone to talk to you and then they're really reluctant to do anything.

Cant get "routine appointments" for 2 weeks plus even though its not really routine, just seems a very very poor standard of care from this practise is the norm now,

Update 20 November 2023
Just arrived for an appointment and witnessed one of the reception staff almost squaring off with a patient cause the screen to sign in wasn't on and then the staff member spoke to all of us waiting like we were children, I was standing there a good 10 minutes whilst one person was on reception and the guy who thought he was Mr bad man was on his own mobile then talking to a staff member who had got greggs.
The reception staff have always been a bit hit n miss here but I've never seen an almost fight cause the staff member thinks he's some gangster, in the wrong sort of job if you're gonna talk to people like that.

Also no longer have late evening appointments or weekends, the only good things about this practise have gone, if I werent so lazy I'd find a better surgery local but they're all under the same group so will probably all have the same issues

Utterly dire this practise now

Oh and almost an hour late for my appointment which to be fair is normal last 6 months or so

-----------------------------
Update May 2021 changed to 4 stars

The pandemic has changed the way the practise works and its actually working a lot better in my opinion.

The reception staff have come a long way in two years, there's still one lady who's very abrupt and you have to push her to check your records to see what doctor has put, but she is the exception now.

The econsult service is absolutely spot on and I think the longest I've waited for a call back was 36hrs over a weekend and the problem was dealt with very quickly .

I had one complaint about an out of hours doctor at the hub on a weekend, but one email and a phone call and this was sorted .

It seems in 2 years there's been a few changes for the better at this practise, still a few things need addressing but have well earned the extra 2 stars from me .

Previous review from 2019 and before

As alot of the reviews have already pointed out the receptionists are horrendous, but they are getting slightly better very very slowly .

The practice offers an E consult service where you describe problems, and it gets sent to a GP who decides if you need to see someone etc, usually works really well unless you get a receptionist that doesn't read your notes,  had a voicemail and an email requesting I ring the practice to make an appointment to see a doctor (so you'd assume quite urgent) yet the receptionist said "no appointments till February and I need to ring Monday morning at 8am" , so I have a GP saying I need to see someone urgent yet the receptionist overrules or doesn't read the notes properly.

If it wasn't for the reception/admin staff (apart from Charlotte and Helen who are fantastic) I would give this surgery a 5 star review as most of the medical staff are brilliant and generally go the extra mile for patients, the practice nurses are lovely and really do look after you as does the blood test lady .
